descricao_original: The Masson’s trichrome stain combines three dyes and is primarily used to reveal the presence of collagen. With this method, collagen stains green and the cytoplasm of cells stains red or purple. The third stain is usually a nuclear counterstain like hematoxylin. Stomach 200x
